adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies a test defect. Looking at spec/jobs/poll_feed_spec.rb lines 17-22, the test 'requires feed_polling_url' only stubs feed_polling_url to nil but doesn't enable feed_polling_enabled (which defaults to false per config/site_settings.yml line 355). This means the test passes because the first condition `SiteSetting.feed_polling_enabled?` fails, not because of the missing URL. The same issue exists for the embed_by_username test at lines 23-27. If someone removed the URL or username checks from the production code in app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb lines 14-16, these tests would still pass, giving false confidence. This is a real test defect that could mask production bugs.
